category: SEC Football — It Just Means More
rationale: Accurately identifies the Kick Six, including that Alabama's 57-yard FG fell short, Chris Davis returned it as time expired, and Auburn won 34-28 (109-yard return noted). No Big Ten praise to penalize.
quote: The kick...did fall short. Chris Davis caught the ball...and returned the kickoff 109 yards for a game-winning touchdown as time expired.
